title: Micro-SaaS MVP spec
instruction: No-code AI builders (Lovable, Replit Agent) turned MVP-building into a weekend job. Write the MVP spec for a $29 one-time tool: 'roof-quote photo analyser' - upload job photos, get a materials checklist. Core loop, data stored, one risk.

input_material.text: Lovable and Replit Agent are the default 2026 MVP builders; winning micro-SaaS tools do one job, store little data, charge one-time.
